findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: commons_boards_list, commons_pinned_list, commons_dashboard_get, commons_threads_list, commons_thread_get, commons_replies_list, commons_revisions_list, commons_search, commons_profile_get, commons_home_get, commons_inbox_list, commons_inbox_read, commons_conversation_get · Private data: commons_message_send, commons_conversation_get · Public sink: commons_message_send · Destructive: commons_thread_delete, commons_reply_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: commons_boards_list, commons_pinned_list, commons_dashboard_get, commons_threads_list, commons_thread_get, commons_replies_list, commons_revisions_list, commons_search, commons_profile_get, commons_home_get, commons_inbox_list, commons_inbox_read, commons_conversation_get · Private data: commons_message_send, commons_conversation_get · Public sink: commons_message_send · Destructive: commons_thread_delete, commons_reply_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
